relations.rationale: Arriving together suggests possible affiliation but does not establish being on the same team.
Arriving together with Uma has no bearing on Cleo's age relative to Uma.
Laughing about a wrong turn near the parking area is unrelated to the group pausing at a river bend for a kingfisher.
Being eager to spot herons doesn't determine whether Cleo ranked the walk highly.
If Bo is on the same team as Uma, and Uma is not on Jude's team, this supports that Bo is also not on Jude's team, but it doesn't directly affect the Uma-Jude relation itself.
If Bo is on Uma's team, and separately Bo is not on Jude's team, these are consistent but the first doesn't logically support the second.
Bo's team membership with Uma has no bearing on Cleo's ranking of the walk.
Noor being tallest supports the claim that Noor stands a head above Jude, consistent with being the tallest.
Noor being tallest is consistent with and supports Jude being the shortest.
Noor's height ranking has no bearing on Cleo's age relative to Bo.
Noor being tallest has no bearing on Jude pointing out a woodpecker.
Noor standing a head above Jude supports Jude being notably shorter than others, consistent with being shortest.
Jude's height ranking has no bearing on Cleo's age relative to Uma.
Jude's height has no bearing on the weather quality.
Cleo being slightly older than Uma doesn't determine Cleo's age relative to Bo.
Cleo being slightly older than Uma supports the idea that Uma is younger than others, consistent with Uma being younger than Bo.

Cleo being younger than Bo doesn't establish the age relation between Uma and Bo directly, but if Cleo is close in age to Uma per other claims this could align, though from this pair alone it's unrelated.
Uma's team relation to Jude has no bearing on Jude spotting a woodpecker.
Uma not being on Jude's team is consistent with but doesn't logically necessitate Bo also not being on Jude's team.
Pausing near a bend where a kingfisher was seen previously is unrelated to Jude spotting a woodpecker in an oak tree.
